messages.author: 7b6a9e367c26ac1c
messages.subject: Error in rexpokit::
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to run a simple DEC model with 22 species and 10 areas. Unfortunately, it has not worked so far.

I have already followed former hints of moving min/max of d and e up/down a bit.

I am always getting the following error that has been posted before:

Warning messages:
1: In optimx.setup(par, fn, gr, hess, lower, upper, method, itnmax,  :
  optimx: No match to available methods
2: In optimx.setup(par, fn, gr, hess, lower, upper, method, itnmax,  :
  Default method when bounds specified is L-BFGS-B to match optim()
3: In optim(par = par, fn = ufn, gr = ugr, lower = lower, upper = upper,  :
  method L-BFGS-B uses 'factr' (and 'pgtol') instead of 'reltol' and 'abstol'
Error in rexpokit::expokit_dgpadm_Qmat(Qmat = Qmat, t = times, transpose_needed) :
  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 4)

Could anyone help me with this, please? I am thankful for any advice why my analysis keeps on failing.

Thanks in advance,

Laura Vecera

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error in rexpokit::
parts: First thing to try is moving the limits in more for d and e. Eg, set the mins to 0.000001. And make sure the check function in the example script reports no problems with you inputs. If those don't work, send me the data. Cheers! Nick
